summary: LogProstyle Inc., a Japanese homebuilder listed on NYSE American, filed Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, attaching a press release confirming payment of the first quarterly installment (US$0.0115/share, ~US$271,525 aggregate) of its previously declared US$0.046/share annual cash dividend. The board declared the dividend on July 13, 2026; record and ex-dividend dates were July 31, 2026; payment occurred August 31, 2026. Remaining three installments are scheduled through April 30, 2027. The filing provides dividend mechanics including Japanese withholding tax rates and remittance timing, but no recommendation or advisors. Watch for continued quarterly payments and any changes to dividend policy or capital allocation.
